# Plans and access

Source of truth: `packages/plans/src/plans.ts`. Every feature carries an (i) icon; in Markdown it is the ⓘ link to the full explanation in [FEATURES_INFO.md](FEATURES_INFO.md). There is no free plan.

## Prices (USD, excl. VAT)

|  | Solo | Pro | Max | Ultra |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Per month | $15 | $24 | $45 | $79 |
| Per year (10 months charged) | $150 | $240 | $450 | $790 |

- Trial: 3 hours of live help within 7 days, card required, Pro features; auto-subscribes to the plan chosen at sign-up.
- Extra hours pack: 15 h for $10, on every plan.
